recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It is a narrow restoration of intended published wording in an active source page and does not require further work-group review.
issue_request: FHIR-24869 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I clarification asking operations.html#response to explain operation success responses with zero out parameters, including that success/error status codes should be used as appropriate and an empty response body may be returned.
initial_application: Git commit 1c5be8bd4b applied FHIR-24869 by adding the zero-output guidance to source/operations.html, but accidentally changed the response sentence to "ne or more output parameters".
additional_context: The same paragraph was later modified by FHIR-28292 to require a single max-1 Resource return value to be returned directly. source/hierarchy.xml shows operations.html is an active build page. Exact Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-24869 found no conflicting community records.
reconciliation: Changed source/operations.html from "ne or more output parameters" to "one or more output parameters" and left the zero-output guidance and FHIR-28292 return-resource rule otherwise unchanged.
source_changes: source/operations.html: restored "one or more output parameters" in the operation response overview.

related_jiras.note: Later changed the same response sentence to the current SHALL/no-wrapping return rule.
Earlier clarification established the one-or-more output-parameter wording that the typo obscured.
